principal_result: For any finite nonempty signature family, common-weak simultaneous-bad locus W is closed and Hc^q(W;Q)=0 for q=0,1,2. Common-triple W can be deleted coherently without changing original D kernel or triple Hc0.
quantifiers_included: every realizable uniform rank4 parent on8
parent-point weak vectors and loop limits
quantifiers_excluded: simultaneous bad points without common weak primal vector
next_discriminator: Control the actual balanced-end map after excision of commonweak W; weak-primal cones for different blocks may be disjoint and actual full-rank positive witnesses occur outsideW. A potential next incidence model retains distinct weak reference vectors, but its two-row height fibers are bilinear and not yet proved acyclic.
secondary_result: Common unsigned rank4 row family plus inherited low vanishings still does not imply D injectivity; explicit abstract graph model, not actual parent geometry.
